item.title: Special court session Friday to decide EMS Medical Director talks
item.description: Kendall County Commissioners Court called a special session for Friday, October 23, at 9 a.m. to consider ending EMS Medical Director negotiations with Archangel EMV LLC and pivoting to the evaluation committee's recommended candidate under RFQ 2026-14.

item.title: Day One of Early Voting Draws 2,165 In-Person Voters in Kendall County
item.description: Kendall County's day-one early voting report shows 2,165 in-person voters and 527 accepted mail ballots for the Nov 3 election.

item.title: Development Watch: Kendall County growth and road projects, week of 2026-10-20
item.description: Weekly development digest: TxDOT is proposing to widen FM 3351 from Desperado Way to SH 46, and this week's county agendas carried no plat or development items.

item.title: Split votes on appraisal district nominees at Boerne ISD special meeting
item.description: Boerne ISD trustees split on adding a fourth Kendall County Appraisal District nominee, passing the motion 4-2-1 on a second try after it failed 2-3-2 minutes earlier. October 14, 2026 special meeting.

item.title: Tax rate up, $214 million in bond orders clear at Boerne ISD's September meeting
item.description: Boerne ISD trustees adopted a $1.0065 tax rate (effectively up 3.14%) and approved up to $214 million in bond orders at the September 21, 2026 regular meeting. Every vote passed 7-0.

item.title: This Weekend in Boerne and Kendall County: October 23-25
item.description: Weekend roundup for October 23-25: pickleball tournament, Boots and Blessings Gala, Boerne Boo, Bluegrass Jam, and more events around Boerne and Kendall County.

item.title: Water Watch: Kendall County water status, October 2026
item.description: Kendall County at Stage 2 drought restrictions, Boerne at Stage 2, and the national drought monitor puts the county in no drought category at all. Canyon Lake is 907.66 feet and 97.1 percent full.

item.title: Heated public comment at commissioners court over former grant coordinator's dismissal
item.description: Former grant coordinator Christina Bergmann addressed commissioners over the elimination of her position; District Attorney Nicole Bishop responded in the meeting.

item.title: Gone But Not Forgotten: annual cemetery history tour returns Oct. 31
item.description: Actors in period dress will portray eight former Boerne residents at the annual cemetery history tour on October 31.

item.title: Boerne ISD board to hold FIRST hearing, policy first reading at Tuesday meeting
item.description: Boerne ISD board meets Tuesday, October 20: FIRST financial rating hearing, first reading of policy FNA(LOCAL), consent items, and a closed session on real property.

item.title: 500 weekend food bags: Boerne volunteers feed students facing food insecurity
item.description: Every Thursday, volunteers pack weekend food bags for more than 500 Boerne ISD students across all 14 campuses.

item.title: Outdoor burning banned across Kendall County for the weekend
item.description: The Fire Marshal banned all outdoor burning for Friday and Saturday as high winds moved through the Hill Country.

item.title: Boerne ISD trustees named 2026 Outstanding School Board
item.description: The Texas Association of School Administrators gave Boerne's school board its highest honor, a first for the district.

item.title: Greyhounds and Chargers Both Win Big: Friday Night Finals, October 16
item.description: Both Boerne ISD varsity teams win big on Friday night, both move to 7-0.

item.title: A new grants manager is hired, but the court never said the name
item.description: At a special called meeting October 15, the Kendall County Commissioners Court voted 4-0 to offer the Grants Manager and Compliance Director position to its top-ranked finalist at $88,552.55, without naming the hire publicly.
